description: Phase 2: Context-Aware Tool Suggestions - Intelligent suggestion system that uses conversation history and Mem0 integration to provide context-aware tool suggestions based on recent tool results

userStories.title: Create entity extractors module structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a module structure for entity extraction so each tool type can have its own extractor.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/core/composio/entity_extractors.py with base EntityExtractor abstract class
Add extract() abstract method that returns Dict[str, List[str]]
Add get_extractor(app_name) factory function
File includes proper type hints and docstrings
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Gmail entity extractor
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract senders, subjects, labels, and email IDs from Gmail API responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GmailExtractor class in orchestrator/core/composio/entity_extractors.py
Extract senders from email headers (name and email)
Extract subjects from email headers
Extract labels (IMPORTANT, urgent flags)
Extract email message IDs
Return format: {'senders': [...], 'subjects': [...], 'labels': [...], 'email_ids': [...]}
Handle empty/malformed responses gracefully
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass

userStories.title: Implement Slack entity extractor
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract channels, mentions, and message IDs from Slack API responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SlackExtractor class in orchestrator/core/composio/entity_extractors.py
Extract channel names from messages
Extract user mentions (@username)
Extract message timestamps/IDs
Return format: {'channels': [...], 'mentions': [...], 'message_ids': [...]}
Handle empty/malformed responses gracefully
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass

userStories.title: Implement GitHub entity extractor
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract PR numbers, issue numbers, repos, and authors from GitHub API responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GitHubExtractor class in orchestrator/core/composio/entity_extractors.py
Extract PR numbers from pull request objects
Extract issue numbers from issue objects
Extract repository names
Extract author usernames
Return format: {'pr_numbers': [...], 'issue_numbers': [...], 'repos': [...], 'authors': [...]}
Handle empty/malformed responses gracefully
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass

userStories.title: Integrate entity extraction into tool executor
userStories.description: As the tool execution pipeline, I need to automatically extract entities after every successful tool call.
acceptanceCriteria: Update orchestrator/core/composio/tool_executor.py to call entity extractor after tool execution
Call get_extractor(app_name) to get correct extractor
If no extractor exists for app, skip extraction (graceful fallback)
Log extraction errors without failing tool execution
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Store extracted entities in Mem0
userStories.description: As the system, I need to save extracted entities to Mem0 after each tool execution for later retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: After entity extraction, create Mem0 memory with type='tool_result'
Include fields: tool, action, entities, user_id, session_id, timestamp
Use existing Mem0 client from orchestrator/modules/memory/
Handle Mem0 failures gracefully (log error, don't block tool execution)
Store asynchronously if possible to avoid blocking
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create context manager module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a module to retrieve recent tool context from Mem0.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/modules/memory/context_manager.py
Add get_recent_tool_context(user_id, session_id, tool_name=None, max_age_minutes=10) function
Query Mem0 for tool_result memories filtered by user_id, session_id, timestamp
If tool_name provided, filter to that tool only
Return list of tool results with entities and timestamps
Return empty list if no context found or Mem0 fails
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass

userStories.title: Create context-aware suggestion generator
userStories.description: As the suggestion system, I need to generate suggestions that reference specific entities from tool results.
acceptanceCriteria: Add generate_context_suggestions(tool_name, entities, limit=2) function to orchestrator/api/tools.py
For Gmail: generate 'Reply to {sender}'s email', 'Reply to the urgent email' based on entities
For Slack: generate 'Send message to {channel}', 'Reply to {mention}' based on entities
For GitHub: generate 'Review PR #{number}', 'Comment on issue #{number}' based on entities
Return 2 context-specific suggestions
Truncate long entity values (e.g., subject lines) to keep suggestions readable
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass

userStories.title: Update suggestions endpoint to support context
userStories.description: As the API, I need to merge context-aware suggestions with curated ones when context is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Update GET /api/tools/{app_name}/suggestions to accept optional user_id and session_id query params
If user_id and session_id provided, call get_recent_tool_context()
If context found: generate 2 context suggestions + 2 curated suggestions (4 total)
If no context: return 4 curated/generated suggestions (Phase 1 behavior)
Add has_context: true/false flag to response
Context suggestions appear first in array
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update frontend to send user and session context
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to pass user_id and session_id to the suggestions API for context retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Update frontend/components/chatbot/chat.tsx handleToolIconClick to include userId and sessionId
Extract userId from Clerk useUser() hook
Use existing chat sessionId or chatbotId as session identifier
API call format: /api/tools/{app}/suggestions?user_id={userId}&session_id={sessionId}
Handle missing userId gracefully (fallback to Phase 1 behavior)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add visual indicator for context-aware suggestions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which suggestions are context-specific so I know they're relevant to my recent actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Update frontend/components/suggestions/types.ts to add isContextAware field to suggestion type
Backend returns suggestions array with metadata: [{text: string, is_context: boolean}, ...]
Update SuggestionChip to show subtle indicator (small dot or icon) for context suggestions
Add tooltip on hover: 'Based on recent {tool} results'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add context source hint to suggestion bar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a hint about why these context suggestions appeared.
acceptanceCriteria: Update ToolSuggestionBar to show small text above chips if has_context is true
Text format: 'Based on recent emails' (or Slack messages, GitHub activity, etc.)
Only show if response includes has_context: true
Subtle styling (small text, muted color)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add analytics for context-aware suggestions
userStories.description: As a product manager, I want to track how often context suggestions are clicked vs generic ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Add is_context_aware field to analytics.track('suggestion_clicked') event
Add context_source field (e.g., 'recent_gmail_results')
Add analytics.track('context_suggestion_generated') event with tool, entity_count, suggestion_count
Update existing analytics to include has_context flag when suggestions load
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add context expiry handling
userStories.description: As the system, I need to expire old tool context so suggestions stay relevant.
acceptanceCriteria: get_recent_tool_context() only returns results from last 10 minutes
Filter by timestamp in Mem0 query
If no recent context (all expired), return empty list
Fallback to generic suggestions works correctly
Typecheck passes
Unit tests verify old context excluded

userStories.title: Handle Mem0 failures gracefully
userStories.description: As the system, I need to handle Mem0 failures without breaking suggestions.
acceptanceCriteria: If Mem0 query fails in get_recent_tool_context(), log error and return empty list
If Mem0 storage fails after tool execution, log error but don't block tool execution
Suggestions endpoint falls back to Phase 1 behavior if context retrieval fails
No user-facing errors, silent degradation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add loading state for context generation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see when context-aware suggestions are being generated if it takes time.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend shows existing loading skeleton while fetching suggestions
No special handling needed (existing isLoadingSuggestions state works)
If context retrieval is slow (>500ms), loading state visible
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add context suggestions to welcome screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want context suggestions even on welcome screen if I've used tools recently.
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome screen checks for recent tool context when tool icon clicked
Uses same handleToolIconClick logic as chat screen
Shows context suggestions if available from last 10 minutes
Falls back to generic suggestions if no context
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create documentation for context suggestion system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need clear documentation on how context-aware suggestions work.
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/CONTEXT_SUGGESTIONS.md explaining architecture
Document entity extraction format for Gmail, Slack, GitHub
Include examples of context → suggestion generation
Document Mem0 schema for tool_result memories
Add inline code comments in entity_extractors.py and context_manager.py
Explain context expiry and fallback behavior
